page.overview:
Who is Canaith?

is a performer and the former owner of at least one magical instrument.

According to Dariax Zaveon, Canaith is a douchebag, and "kind of a total dick" who pretended to be a professional musician.

In 843 PD, Canaith was traveling and performing in different places, and in Byroden he met Opal and Dariax, who, since they didn't like him, decided to steal his mandolin, thinking it would be a good present for their friend, Dorian Storm. However, they didn't kill Canaith, who was still alive last time they checked.

Eventually, when the three friends reunited with their group in Kymal that same year, Dariax surprised Dorian with the new instrument, explaining he thought it would be better in the genasi's hands; however, when Dorian tried to attune to it, he discovered not only that his new instrument was magical, but that it would magically damage him if he did not attune to it properly, which he eventually managed to do.
